svg.title: Stage-001: the AND door. Tap the bar, the door splits, fill both holes, the bar glows

g.text: no dashed slot: no joined key in the tray
wobble plays: 2500 ms after the room opens untouched,
then every 6000 ms until a touch; when a key is dropped
on the unsplit door; on a tap outside the bar; hint button
the dropped key flies back (200 ms), then the bar wobbles
the bar glided 8.6 px to the centre; only the sun hole glows

svg.text: 4. both filled: the bar glows, doors open

g.text: used keys stay in the tray

svg.text: hint wobble (AND_BAR_HINT): rotate about the bar centre, each step in-out, drawn 3× (door scale)
